source_name: OTP Bank Nyrt. — Hírek / sajtóközlemények (corporate newsroom)
why_relevant: OTP's own Hungarian-language newsroom is where appointments of deputy CEOs, division heads and subsidiary CEOs are first announced (observed items: 'Új vezérigazgató-helyettesi kinevezés', 'Állandóság és megújulás az OTP Bank vezetőségében', 'Vezetőváltás a Merkantil Banknál', 'Új vezérigazgató az OTP Alapkezelő élén'). Highest-precision origin layer for HU leadership moves and org changes.

source_name: OTP Group Investor Relations — Company announcements (regulated disclosures)
why_relevant: OTP is BÉT-listed, so board (Igazgatóság) and supervisory board (Felügyelőbizottság) changes must be disclosed here under MAR/Capital Markets Act. Structured, dated, legally binding version of the leadership-change fact; complements the softer press room.

source_name: OTP Bank corporate governance / Board of Directors roster
why_relevant: Current-state roster of board, committees and senior management. Diffing snapshots over time detects org changes that were never separately announced.

source_name: OTP Bank karrieroldal — all open jobs
why_relevant: Employer-owned vacancy list for OTP Bank and OTP Group. Job-posting volume and role mix are the leading indicator of hiring intent and quiet org build-out (e.g. new AI/data/payments teams) before any press release.

source_name: MBH Bank Nyrt. — Sajtószoba (press room)
why_relevant: MBH (Hungary's second-largest bank, post-MKB/Budapest Bank/Takarék merger) publishes deputy-CEO appointments and reorganisations here with dated permalinks; observed a 2026-07-29 item announcing a new business deputy CEO and the reassignment of the incumbent. Continuing post-merger integration makes MBH the richest source of org-change events in HU.

source_name: MBH Bank — Vezérigazgató és helyettesei (CEO and deputy CEOs roster)
why_relevant: Authoritative current list of MBH's executive board under the corporate-governance (társaságirányítás) section. Snapshot-diffing gives org changes even when no press release is issued.

source_name: MBH Bank organigram (PDF org chart, deputy-CEO areas)
why_relevant: A published organisation chart mapping deputy-CEO areas — the single most valuable artefact for the 'organization changes' topic, because successive versions reveal restructurings directly. The observed file is dated 2023-05-01, so a newer revision is likely at a similar path.

source_name: MBH Jelzálogbank Nyrt. — Közzétételek (issuer disclosures)
why_relevant: MBH's listed mortgage-bank arm is a BÉT issuer and states it discloses under the Capital Markets Act, MAR 596/2014/EU and the BÉT rulebook — meaning board/management changes appear here as formal, dated disclosures for the MBH group perimeter.

source_name: K&H Bank — közlemények (announcements index)
why_relevant: K&H (KBC Group) posts group news and official notices here; the press subtree carries CEO-change items (e.g. 'új vezérigazgató a K&H csoport élén'). Primary origin for K&H leadership facts.

source_name: K&H Bank — a Bank vezetősége (management/board roster)
why_relevant: Names the board members and deputy CEOs (observed entries include the CEO, board chair, and deputy-CEO board members). Diffable current-state roster; also confirms KBC-appointed non-executive members, useful for parent-company influence mapping.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary Zrt. — Sajtóközlemények
why_relevant: Erste HU's own press-release stream, covering Erste Bank Hungary and its subsidiaries plus relayed Erste Group items. Expected origin point for head-of-retail / board appointment announcements in the cell.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary Zrt. — Vállalatirányítás / hivatalos közzétételek
why_relevant: The corporate-governance 'official disclosures' subtree, organised by year/month (an item dated 2026-01-23 was observed). This is where statutory notices — including board/officer changes — are filed rather than PR'd. Note the site's own path spelling 'hivatalalos-kozzetetelek'.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. (HU) — Sajtószoba
why_relevant: Raiffeisen HU's press room, including a thematic 'Üzleti világ' section. Raiffeisen HU had a materially churny board in 2025-2026 (appointments effective 2026-07-28, a resignation effective 2025-12-31, a term ending 2026-07-28), so this is an active-event source.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. (HU) — Vezetőség
why_relevant: Current management/board roster for Raiffeisen HU; the reliable way to confirm effective dates of the 2026 board rotation observed in press coverage.

source_name: CIB Bank Zrt. — Sajtószoba (press releases + announcements)
source_subtype: issuer press room + statutory notice board
why_relevant: CIB (Intesa Sanpaolo) runs a press room split into 'Sajtóközlemények' and 'Announcements and Notifications' (bank_kozzetetelek), plus a year-indexed legacy archive on net.cib.hu. CIB is currently a net exporter of senior talent to MBH, so its departures are leading indicators.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Hungary Zrt. — Rólunk / sajtóközlemények (PDF press-release store)
why_relevant: UniCredit HU publishes press information as dated PDFs under a predictable content path (/content/dam/cee2020-pws-hu/Rolunk/sajtokozlemenyek_magyar/<YYYY>/<YYYYMM>/<file>.pdf), observed for 2025-04 and 2025-11 items. Appointment notices for the HU entity land in this store.

source_name: GRÁNIT Bank Nyrt. — Befektetőknek (investor relations / press room)
why_relevant: Gránit listed on BÉT (Standard category) after its Dec-2024 IPO, so it is now a disclosing issuer: the investor page hosts company documents, analyses and a press room. A fast-growing digital bank means frequent hiring and org build-out.

source_name: BÉT (Budapesti Értéktőzsde) issuer pages & Kibocsátói hírek — for OTP, Gránit, MBH Jelzálogbank
why_relevant: The exchange is the mandated publication venue for HU listed banks' disclosures, including board/supervisory-board changes and IR-contact designations. It is the canonical, timestamped mirror of every issuer's own filing, so it de-duplicates and time-anchors the issuer press rooms. Observed direct PDF filings under bet.hu/newkibdata/ (e.g. Gránit's IR-contact notice naming its deputy CEO, and its 2024 annual report).

source_name: MagNet Magyar Közösségi Bank Zrt. — corporate site
source_subtype: issuer corporate site (press subsection not confirmed)
why_relevant: Smallest actor in the cell but an active consolidator (Polgári Bank acquisition), which drives org change and integration hiring. Its own site is the origin layer; note that MagNet leadership statements were observed mainly via third-party interviews rather than its own newsroom.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) — member registry
why_relevant: Canonical roster of HU bank issuers with official legal names and site links (tagId per member: 41=Raiffeisen, 47=UniCredit HU, 7=CIB, 29=MagNet). Use it to enumerate the issuer universe exhaustively so no bank's press room is missed, and to resolve official name spellings for the glossary.

source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár (Hungarian company registry aggregator) — bank company records
why_relevant: Company-register-derived records list officers (vezető tisztségviselők) and registered-data changes for each bank Zrt./Nyrt. This is the legally-filed counterpart of a press announcement and often records officer changes that were never publicised — a strong cross-check for the issuer-origin layer.

source_name: EMIS company profile — Erste Bank Hungary Zrt. (key executives)
why_relevant: Commercial database maintaining 'key executives' lists per HU bank entity. Useful as a paid cross-check when an issuer's own roster page is stale, but it is a secondary compiler, not an origin source.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary — Hirdetmények (official notices portal)
why_relevant: Separate statutory-notice portal on a distinct host (gate.erstebank.hu). Mostly product/pricing notices, but it is the formal notice channel of the entity and worth monitoring alongside the governance archive so no legally required org notice is missed.

source_name: OTP Bank karrier content hub (employer-brand pages)
why_relevant: Employer-branding pages describe career tracks, onboarding and training programmes for branch and Contact Center staff. Changes in the described tracks and programmes are a soft signal about which functions the bank is expanding or automating away.

source_name: MNB — Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions & orders search)
why_relevant: Central searchable database of all MNB supervisory decisions, filterable by period, sector (pénzpiac, biztosítási piac, tőkepiac, pénztár) and type (engedélyezés / jogérvényesítés / piacfelügyelet / fogyasztóvédelem). Engedélyezési (licensing) decisions include the statutory prior approval of 'vezető állású személy' appointments at banks, payment institutions and financial enterprises — i.e. named executive appointments with dates and institution, the legally-forced spine of A5.

source_name: MNB — Az MNB határozatok számozása (decision numbering scheme)
why_relevant: Documents the H-<type>-<sector>-<serial>/<year> code system (e.g. H-EN-I- = engedélyezés, money-market/credit-institution sector). Essential decoding key that lets a collector filter for exactly the licensing decisions covering executive appointments and to construct/recognise decision IDs.

source_name: MNB — Személyi engedélyek / vezető állású személy engedélyezése (licensing subject pages)
why_relevant: Defines WHICH roles at which institution types require MNB prior approval (hitelintézet, pénzügyi vállalkozás, pénzforgalmi intézmény, befektetési alapkezelő, biztosító) and the procedural timeline. Sets the scope and expected latency of the whole legally-forced A5 spine, and lists per-sector sub-pages that are themselves crawl targets.

source_name: MNB — Formanyomtatványok (fit-and-proper questionnaires for executives/owners)
why_relevant: The 'jó üzleti hírnév' / fit-and-proper data-sheet forms reveal exactly which attributes about an executive are captured by the regulator (roles, prior mandates, qualifying holdings) — useful for designing the person-entity schema and for knowing what is legally on file even when not published.
